scope: Proposition 13.5 (A deterministic atom partition) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 159. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Retain the weakly mixing correspondence K from the start of this section. Let Θ be a PVM of total mass I on the boundary-isomorphism space E , acting on K0 ⊗ K1, with the precomposition and postcomposition covariances of Equations (13.2) and (13.3). Suppose that diagonal ρ fixes Θ and that its two copies on K0 ⊗ K1 ⊗ K2 commute. Then K has an orthogonal partition into nonzero finite-dimensional subspaces permuted by π(Γ) and ρ(Λ). The Γ-action on the partition is free and has finitely many orbits.
